topic.angle: How many neurons in an adult brain

card.title: How many neurons in a brain?

body.question: About how many neurons are in an adult human brain?
body.reveal: The adult human brain is estimated to contain 86±8 billion neurons, with a roughly equal number (85±10 billion) of non-neuronal cells.

probes.question: True or false: the adult human brain is estimated to contain 86±8 billion neurons.
True or false: the brain has a roughly equal number of non-neuronal cells.
